proxy_overlap_rule: Exclude HYG,SPY,IEF from every proxy response set; do not infer independence of underlying holdings. These are mixed ETF excess-return proxies, especially HYG, not pure Credit/term factors.
evaluation: 29 monthly outer tests: 2024-02 through2026-06, determined by frozen common113 months. Each window84 months ends before test. Inner expanding trains60/72, next12-month validation; pooled24 validation losses choose lambda; refit84 then score exactly one subsequent month. All history already retrospectively inspectable; exploratory pseudo-out-of-sample, not untouched confirmation.
targets: Production fixed prior: legacy Credit-only .20 IG/.40 HY/.30 EM; zero for controls. Proxy fixed target: one unit on HYG for credit responses, one unit on IEF for treasury controls, one unit on SPY for equity controls. The latter is a class-proxy anchor, not a transported economic Credit-beta target. Small2/Small3: fold-local weighted OLS on Rates+Credit or Equity+Rates+Credit for credit funds; own Rates/Equity factor for controls, remaining targets zero. Different native factor units across lanes prohibit level comparisons.
weights: Same audited global weighted-intercept L1 adapter as E2; spans uniform/36. Fold-local weighted standardisation; final-fit inputs only past84 months. This is not production rolling-mean preprocessing.
scores: Conditional reconstruction of held-out ETF returns using contemporaneous realised factor returns. No tradable forecast or strategy claim. Normalise losses by each asset's first60-month response variance, frozen before evaluation. No empirical true-loading error.
scenarios: Fixed +/- isolated factor shocks of one factor SD estimated on first60 months, plus equal-sign joint shock; compare consecutive fitted scenario responses (stability, not accuracy). Save raw betas and target distances. Use same response scale.

uncertainty.method: Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap on paired cohort-mean monthly loss differences; all assets/methods use same date indices
uncertainty.interval: percentile 2.5/97.5 for mean paired NMSE difference
uncertainty.caveat: 29 months, overlapping training windows, stationarity assumption and historical data revisions limit inference; intervals are exploratory and pointwise

verification: Check every train/validation/test cutoff and all28 transition dates; mutate all future data including current test and rerun selected earlier fits; truncate at cutoff and require same coefficients/choices. Independently check weighted small-regression targets and direct prediction. Compare two stationary-bootstrap index algorithms exactly, including forced circular wrap and a deliberate no-wrap defect. Missing rows/corrupt losses must fail.
provenance: Use immutable public-price-derived response snapshot, production NAV snapshot and frozen universe. Production-factor composition/vintages lack public-rebuild certification. Proxy lane uses only public-price-derived ETF response columns with documented existing Yahoo/^IRX rebuild recipe; no fresh download or historical-vintage guarantee. No independent dated holdings/duration/spread reference is available.
scope: No new package dependency, core change, optimiser/backtest or empirical recovered-truth claim. Preserve all prior runs. E5 must separate completion of these eligible snapshot lanes from unavailable independent exposure validation.
